notes.title: First major update for our demo!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Community!

Big Demo Update
Today we released a big demo update. The update includes a ton of new visual effects and sound effects that should make hitting your enemies even more satisfying. Additionally, we used the time since the initial demo release to revamp our abilities and updated all of them, including a few new ones. Alongside all these changes, we also included many quality-of-life improvements - too many to list them all out here. So, grab your friends and play the updated version yourself.

🕹️ Cool Stuff Inside:

 Visual and Audio Update
 New and revamped Abilities
 Quality-of-life improvements
 New target practice map


📅 New Release Window:
You might have noticed that we have a new release window now. We are planning the full release of Buhei to happen during Q2 of 2025. Until then, practice your aim on our new target practice map and try out all weapons and abilities included in the demo. When the full release hits, expect even more funny combinations to try out yourself!

🎙️ Join Us on Discord:
Want to share epic moments or find your next opponent? Join our Discord community and connect with us and awesome other players!
